text:
michael: Heads-up — onboarding a new tenant (org: orion) next week in eu-south-3. Need to request GPU and networking increases so we don't hit a hard block during the pilot.

michael: Target capacity: 8 p5 instances for model training/validation, plus 16 g5 for inference burst. ETA for start: 2026-04-06. Prefer no manual approvals mid-deploy.

alex: Got it. Can you paste the AWS account ID and the preferred AZs? Also include whether these are spot or on-demand.

michael: Account: 123456789012. AZs: eu-south-3a/b if possible. Mostly on-demand for the p5s (sustained), g5s will be mixed (on-demand + spot).

priya: Quick question — what steady-state hours are you expecting? If this is sustained 24/7 throughput we should talk about reserved/dedicated capacity instead of quota bumps.

michael: Initial pilot will run 8h/day, 5 days/week for 4 weeks. If results look good, we'll scale to 24/7. So start with quota bump only, but we'll likely convert to Dedicated in ~6 weeks.

sam_ops: For AWS support request, request the following limits: 
- p5: raise Running On-Demand instances to 8 and vCPU equivalent if asked.
- g5: raise Running On-Demand instances to 16, and request a corresponding increase to Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) / private IPv4 pool to accommodate ~40 IPs.
- EC2 instance quota: request Increase for p5 & g5 accelerator count in eu-south-3 region.

sam_ops: Also ask for EC2 in-use IPv4 addresses limit bump for that account + increase for network interfaces per AZ. Attach use-case: "Redwood Inference tenant onboarding — model inference and training pilot, non-production, short-term burst then potential scale."

alex: I'll open the AWS Support case now. We'll use service code: EC2-Limit-Update and include quota ids for p5/g5 if AWS asks. I'll cc infra-billing for cost awareness.

infra-bot: [ticket-created] Support case #CASE-2026-000987 opened with AWS for account 123456789012 requesting p5/g5 quota increases and ENI/elastic IP adjustments. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case?caseId=CASE-2026-000987

michael: Thanks. Can you also note the required start window in the ticket: need approval by 2026-04-03 to allow time to provision and smoke-test.

alex: Added start window and tagged the ticket with priority: high. Also included expected cost delta estimate: ~$38k/month if fully utilized (worst-case), pilot expected ~10-15% of that.

priya: Heads-up to finance — please allocate temporary cost center ORION-PILOT.

sam_ops: When AWS responds, if they ask for a CIDR allocation or VPC quotas, we need to pre-create the VPC subnets and share the VPC ID. Michael, can you confirm VPC will be ready by 2026-04-01?

michael: Yes, infra team will create VPC eu-south-3-main and subnets by 2026-03-30. Will paste VPC ID here once done.

alex: One more: request ENI per instance mapping — p5 uses 8 ENIs per instance at our config, g5 uses 4. I added that detail to the case to avoid back-and-forth.

michael: Pasted VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. Subnets: subnet-a, subnet-b done.

infra-bot: [aws-ticket-update] AWS assigned severity: Normal. They asked for expected launch date (answered) and to confirm no EC2 Spot Fleet automation is required.

sam_ops: If AWS approves partial capacity (e.g., only 4 p5), we'll queue a change in the scheduler to gracefully degrade training and shift some runs to another region. I'll draft the fallback policy.

priya: Good plan. Keep me posted if the ticket gets any follow-up explaining they need AZ-level capacity checks.

alex: Follow-up: Ticket updated with cost center and VPC info. ETA from AWS currently 3-5 business days. I'll post updates here when we hear back. :thumbsup:

michael: Thanks all. Will hold off on starting the deployment until we have a final quota confirmation.

alex: FYI, adding a small checklist for ops action once approved:
- confirm quota numbers in AWS console
- provision IAM role for orion engines
- apply autoscaling guardrails
- run smoke tests with a single p5 and two g5s

sam_ops: I'll own smoke tests. Priya please own cost validation after provisioning.

priya: On it.

infra-bot: [reminder] If AWS approves, remember to update the region capacity spreadsheet: /sheets/infra-region-capacity (edited)

michael: Great, closing for now — will ping when VPC CIDRs confirmed in the ticket.

alex: Thanks — keeping this thread pinned for updates.
